newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up ahead of settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up ahead of settlement day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to rise on blue chip buying on Monday amid positive sentiment after Friday's 1997/98 budget, but dealers said gains would be limited because of settlement day on Tuesday.
"The budget is good for the market and select blue chips will rise on fresh buying," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "But tomorrow's settlement day would limit the gains."

On Satarday, the Karachi 100-share index rose 9.56 points, or 0.61 percent, to end at 1,585.44 points amid 30 gainers and two losers. The bourse held a post-budget computerised trading session on Saturday, usually a holiday. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
